author: Phanlop Boonleua
how: Superseded on 2026-11-01 by data/roles/<role_id>.json, which adds weights, levels and work-style. Kept as the record of which skills came from which source. Skills read from each role's source PDFs (numbers refer to files in pdf/). 'suggested' skills are common for the role but not stated in the sources; confirm them with Bangkok postings (step 2) before use. Weights are not set yet.

software-engineer.note: Source 04 covers education and soft skills only; technical skills need a source (postings in step 2).

web-developer.note: Source 05 compares web vs software developers; few soft skills listed.

backend-developer.note: Evidence taken from the back-end section of 23 (Full-Stack Developer JD); 23 added to this role's sources in roles.json. No source lists soft skills yet.

mobile-developer.note: Source 26 lists soft skills only; platform tools need a source.

cloud-engineer.note: Source 08 compares cloud engineer vs architect; provider names (AWS, Azure, GCP) come from 11 and should be confirmed for this role.

network-administrator.note: Source 02 is an interview-question article; skills are inferred from the questions asked.
